answer:
I don't have any record of museum or gallery visits in December, so I can't give you a count — from what I remember, that month isn't covered at all.

The art-related visits I do have are:
- **Modern Art Museum** — guided workshop, January 2023
- **Natural History Museum** — with your niece, 8 February 2023
- **The Art Cube** — "Disrupting Reality" opening night, 15 February 2023

If you visited somewhere in December, tell me which and I'll add it.
